lines:
  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    note: "The clergy and church-employee adjustments to this line are out of scope here. Step 5 question 1 and the Clergy and Church employees rules would replace line 1z with line 1z less the Schedule SE amount. That situation is screened per person (person.se_screen); the catalog has no return-level aggregate for it, so no refusal is attached at this line."
  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.mw_not_earned}
    note: "Each spouse makes the inclusion choice separately (TIP). I read person.mw_not_earned as each person's line 8s amount that the person did not elect to include, and add it across persons. A plain copy of Schedule 1 line 8s would ignore the elections."
  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}
  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]
    note: "The input interface is closed and has no combat pay amount. Nontaxable combat pay is screened (s8812.combat_pay), so that case is refused. In the case the tool computes, there is no combat pay and the line is zero."
  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}

  # ---------- Shared helpers: children, filing status, limits ----------
  - id: eic.h_kids
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn_child, {const: true}]}
    note: "Read dependent.eic_ssn_child as an EIC qualifying child (after any tiebreak) who has an SSN valid for the EIC."
  - id: eic.h_qc_count
    printed: "(helper)"

      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one

  - id: eic.h_has_qc

  - id: eic.h_k0

    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 0, type: Count}]}

    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_q45, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}

  # ---------- Step 4 ----------
  - id: eic.h_age_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Persons on the return at least age 25 but under age 65 at the end of 2025"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [person.eic_age25, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [person.eic_under65, {const: true}]}
  - id: eic.h_age_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: you, or your spouse if filing jointly, were at least 25 but under 65"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
  - id: eic.h_died_gate
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: spouse died in 2025 or return for a decedent (see Pub. 596)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach34, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.died_this_year, {const: true}]}
  - id: eic.h_s4_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4 passed (no qualifying child)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    note: "Step 4 question 6 (can be claimed as a dependent) is read from sa.dependent."
  - id: eic.h_s4_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 3 No or question 5 Yes (check the box on line 27c)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
  - id: eic.h_s34_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_pass, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_pass, {const: true}]}
  - id: eic.h_reach5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 to 4 passed (go to Step 5)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach34, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_pass, {const: true}]}]}

  # ---------- Step 5, question 2 and 3 ----------
  - id: eic.h_sc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of Schedules C filed"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.sc_count}
  - id: eic.h_uses_wsb
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: self-employed at any time in 2025 (use Worksheet B)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_sc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    note: "Self-employment is read as filing any Schedule C. Clergy and church-employee income and statutory employees are outside the computed scope."
  - id: eic.h_s5_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5 question 3 (or Worksheet B line 4b and question 5) passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}
  - id: eic.h_s5_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 4b zero or less, or question 5 No (check the box on line 27c)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, le: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
            - {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}
  - id: eic.h_reach_ws
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 to 5 passed (figure the credit)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_pass, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_show_wsb4
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_show_wsb6
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B Part 5 is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach_ws, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_uses_wsa
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach_ws, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}]}

  # ---------- Worksheet B, Part 4 ----------
  - id: eic.h_se_total
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B lines 1e and 2c, combined for you and your spouse"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.eic_se}
    note: "person.eic_se is read as each person's Worksheet B Part 1 line 1e (Schedule SE filers) or Part 2 line 2c (Schedule C, line 31). Part 3 (statutory employees) is out of scope and taken as zero."
  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_se_total, eic.earned_income]}
    shown_when: eic.h_show_wsb4
  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    shown_when: eic.h_show_wsb6
    note: "Line 6 is reached only when line 4b is more than zero (a STOP applies otherwise), so a floor at zero does not change any value that is used."

  # ---------- Worksheet A ----------
  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.earned_income}
    shown_when: eic.h_uses_wsa
  - id: eic.h_a_in
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 1 falls within the EIC Table rows for the column"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}
  - id: eic.h_a_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, no children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, one child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, two children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, three or more children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_a_in, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k0, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k1, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k2, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k3, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a_t3
    shown_when: eic.h_uses_wsa
    note: "Amounts below the first table row ($1) or at or above the column's limit have no credit (the table footnotes say you can't take the credit), so they are entered as zero rather than looked up."
  - id: eic.h_show_a3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A continues past line 2 (line 2 is not zero)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsa, {const: true}]}, {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}]}
  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}
    shown_when: eic.h_show_a3
  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}
    shown_when: eic.h_show_a3
  - id: eic.h_g_in
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 1040 line 11b falls within the EIC Table rows for the column"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}
  - id: eic.h_g_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 11b, no children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_g_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 11b, one child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_g_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 11b, two children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_g_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 11b, three or more children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_low_agi
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 4 Yes, or line 3 less than $10,620 / $23,350 ($17,730 / $30,470 if married filing jointly)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_thresh]}
  - id: eic.h_show5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 5 is filled in"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_show_a3, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_low_agi, {const: false}]}]}
  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "If you have no qualifying children who have valid SSNs, is the amount on line 3 less than $10,620 ($17,730 if married filing jointly)? 1 or more qualifying children who have valid SSNs, is the amount on line 3 less than $23,350 ($30,470 if married filing jointly)? Yes. Leave line 5 blank; enter the amount from line 2 on line 6. No. Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_g_in, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_g_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k0, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_g_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_g_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k1, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_g_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_g_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k2, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_g_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_g_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k3, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_g_t3
    shown_when: eic.h_show5
    note: "The value is the table credit for line 3 and is computed either way. It is used only when line 5 is filled in (eic.h_low_agi false); otherwise line 6 takes line 2."
  - id: eic.h_a_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Smaller of Worksheet A lines 5 and 2"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}
  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_low_agi, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.line2
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_low_agi, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_a_min
    shown_when: eic.h_show_a3

  # ---------- Worksheet B, Parts 5 to 7 ----------
  - id: eic.h_b_in
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 6 falls within the EIC Table rows for the column"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}
  - id: eic.h_b_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for Worksheet B line 6, no children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_b_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for Worksheet B line 6, one child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_b_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for Worksheet B line 6, two children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_b_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for Worksheet B line 6, three or more children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_b7
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: look up the amount on line 6 in the EIC Table"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_in, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k0, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k1, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k2, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_k3, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t3
  - id: eic.h_b9
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 9: are the amounts on lines 8 (Form 1040 line 11b) and 6 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.wsb_6]}
  - id: eic.h_b_low
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 9 Yes, or line 8 less than the line 10 threshold"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b9, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_thresh]}
  - id: eic.h_b10
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 10: EIC Table credit for line 8 (Form 1040 line 11b)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.line5}
    note: "Worksheet B line 8 is Form 1040 line 11b, the same amount as Worksheet A line 3. Its table lookup is therefore the same as Worksheet A line 5."
  - id: eic.h_b_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Smaller of Worksheet B lines 10 and 7"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.h_b10, eic.h_b7]}
  - id: eic.h_b11
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 11: your earned income credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_low, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_b7
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_low, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_b_min

  # ---------- Results ----------
  - id: eic.h_ws_credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Credit from the worksheet that applies (Worksheet A line 6 or Worksheet B line 11)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_b11
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.line6
  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can take the earned income credit (Steps 1 to 5 passed and the worksheet credit is more than zero)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach_ws, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_ws_credit, {const: 0}]}
    refuses: [eic.h_2555_gate, eic.h_nra, eic.h_ws1_needed, eic.h_died_gate]
    note: "Read as: the flowchart and worksheet reach a credit without any STOP. A zero on Worksheet A line 2 or Worksheet B line 7 means you can't take the credit. Step 6 (the IRS figures the credit) is not modelled; the credit is figured with the worksheet."
  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit (Form 1040, line 27a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_ws_credit
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
  - id: eic.h_c1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 2 answered No"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: false}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_c34
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4 instructs checking the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach34, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_27c, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_27c, {const: true}]}
  - id: eic.h_c5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 4b or question 5 instructs checking the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_27c, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_c6
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 2 or Worksheet B line 7 is zero"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach_ws, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b7, {const: 0}]}
  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c if you do not want to claim the earned income credit or if you have been instructed to check the box in the instructions for line 27a."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c1, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c34, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c5, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c6, {const: true}]}
    note: "Covers every place the line 27a instructions say to check the box, each on the path where it is reached. The election not to claim the credit has no input in the closed interface and is not modelled. Nonresident aliens (who are also told to check the box) are refused at eic.eligible."
  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses (Step 3, question 6 No)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach34, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
    note: "The flowchart tells every filer who answers No to Step 3 question 6 to check the box. The Special rule for separated spouses applies only to married filers not filing jointly, so the box is limited to the married-filing-separately and married head-of-household path through questions 4 and 5."
